Article 16

1. Forms of Violence against Women include: a. physical violence;
b. sexual violence;
c. economic violence; andd. psychological violence.
2. Forms of physical violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a, include any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, unconsciousness and/or causes death.
3. Forms of sexual violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, include sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced intercourse with others for commercial purposes and/or other non-commercial purposes.
4. Forms of economic violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c, include neglect of Women by not providing proper livelihood.
5. Forms of psychological violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter d include acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or other psychological suffering to the victim.

Article17 (1) Every Woman victim of violence must receive protection in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

2. Protection of Women victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be provided to Women who experience violence in the family environment, the Community, the education sector, offices and the business sector.

Article 15

1. Every Woman victim of violence has the right to obtain protection and continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage.
2. The handling of Women victims of violence must be kept confidential unless otherwise determined by the provisions of laws and regulations.
3. In the event of violence, every victim has the right to obtain professional Assistance services based on the victim's condition and needs.
4. The Regional Government provides integrated Services for comprehensive and integrated protection and handling.
5. Integrated services as referred to in paragraph (4) shall be coordinated by the Regional Apparatus responsible for Women's Empowerment and child protection affairs.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

ELUCIDATION

ON

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

ELUCIDATION

ON

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

Article 16

1. Forms of Violence against Women include: a. physical violence;
b. sexual violence;
c. economic violence; andd. psychological violence.
2. Forms of physical violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a, include any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, unconsciousness and/or causes death.
3. Forms of sexual violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, include sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced intercourse with others for commercial purposes and/or other non-commercial purposes.
4. Forms of economic violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c, include neglect of Women by not providing proper livelihood.
5. Forms of psychological violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter d include acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or other psychological suffering to the victim.

Article17 (1) Every Woman victim of violence must receive protection in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

2. Protection of Women victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be provided to Women who experience violence in the family environment, the Community, the education sector, offices and the business sector.

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

ELUCIDATION

ON

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

ELUCIDATION

ON

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

Article 1

4. Regional Governance is the administration of government affairs by the regional government and the regional house of representatives according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy in the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
5. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional People's Representative Institution which is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.
6. Woman is a person or human being who has a womb, experiences menstruation, pregnancy, gives birth to children and breastfeeds.
7. Women's Empowerment is an effort to obtain access to and control over economic, political, social, and cultural resources, so that women can manage themselves and increase self-confidence to be able to play a role and participate actively in solving problems, so as to be able to build capacity and self-concept.
8. Protection of Women is all efforts to protect and provide a sense of security to women and the fulfillment of their rights through consistent, structured, and systematic attention.

11. Every Person is an individual or corporation, whether a legal entity or not a legal entity.

20. Integrated Service is the provision of integrated, multi-aspect, cross-functional and cross-sectoral services for Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence.

ELUCIDATION

ON

REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF BANDUNG

NUMBER 7 OF 2025

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or deprived by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that makes women vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, however in certain discriminatory conditions, the government is obliged to implement affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so as not to experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice. Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

22- The Bandung City Government as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Bandung City, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations in order to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Bandung City. This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and life needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.
